target: CDKN2A nonsynonymous mutation status, not treatment outcome
cohort: local accession-mapped TCGA-PAAD samples; grouping by patient barcode
splits: 3 fixed patient-grouped stratified splits seeds17,29,43,test_size approximately25percent
estimator: StandardScaler training-only + balanced LogisticRegression C1,L2,max_iter2000, no tuning
missing_age: training-median imputation applied to test; no target leakage; missing sex encoded0 per historical source convention, not inferred sex
metrics: held-out AUC,average precision,Brier,logloss; no confidence or model superiority claim
limits: small retrospective cohort, only3splits, overlapping patients across repeats; patient labels not clinical decisions; no external cohort or causal inference; no GNN retraining
